response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(NULLIF(fillcount, 0)) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS value FROM per_order), above_first AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.value AS first_excess FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.value), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS value FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.avg_fill) AS average_fill_quantity, AVG(a.first_excess) AS average_first_excess, AVG(a.avg_fill - b.value) AS average_second_excess FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b WHERE a.avg_fill > b.value;
